dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: Non-germinal-center B-cell phenotype by Hans algorithm (CD10 negative, BCL6 positive, MUM1/IRF4 positive in about 70%)

dx_hans_not_abc.quote: Gene-expression cell-of-origin and LymphGen genetic subtype (MYD88, CD79B, etc.) are not available
dx_hans_not_abc.note: Implies IHC is a surrogate ('activated B-cell-like by IHC'; GEP not available) without stating it explicitly.

stage_iii.quote: I am counting the multifocal splenic lesions as stage IV, as the PET read does

stage_spleen_nodal.quote: I am counting the multifocal splenic lesions as stage IV, as the PET read does

stage_bulky_b_symptoms.quote: retroperitoneal mass 11.0 x 8.1 cm, SUVmax 22.4, bulky at 10 cm or more

mn_stage_iv.quote: Ann Arbor stage IV-B with bulky disease (provisional, see note)

mol_de_not_dh.quote: Non-GCB (activated B-cell-like by IHC) DLBCL with a double-expressor phenotype

mn_calls_double_hit.quote: so this is not double-hit or triple-hit lymphoma

prog_ipi_3.quote: IPI is 3 (age 62: 1; LDH above ULN: 1; stage IV: 1; ECOG 1: 0; extranodal sites: 0), which is high-intermediate
prog_ipi_3.note: Total IPI 3 is correct but the stage point is attributed to stage IV rather than III.

prog_cns_ipi_intermediate.quote: Score 3 falls in the high-risk tier (3 to 6) of the original CNS-IPI
prog_cns_ipi_intermediate.note: Score of 3 computed correctly without the spleen, but misclassified as high rather than intermediate risk.

tx_curative_pola_or_rchop.quote: 6 cycles every 21 days on the POLARIX schedule

tx_pola_preferred.quote: Fallback if polatuzumab is not accessible: standard R-CHOP-21 x6
tx_pola_preferred.note: Pola-R-CHP preferred with R-CHOP fallback, but rationale cites IPI rather than the non-GCB benefit.

tx_isrt_residual_bulk.quote: If end-of-treatment PET shows Deauville 4 or 5 at the retroperitoneal site, refer to radiation oncology for consolidative involved-site RT

mn_da_epoch.quote: I do not recommend DA-EPOCH-R, since there is no double-hit

hbv_prophylaxis.quote: Start entecavir 0.5 mg PO daily now, before the first rituximab dose, and continue for at least 12 months after the last rituximab dose

hbv_dna_lft_monitoring.quote: Monitor HBV DNA and ALT every 1 to 3 months during and after therapy

cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.quote: Decision: offer CNS prophylaxis with intrathecal methotrexate 12 mg

mn_mandates_cns_prophylaxis.quote: Decision: offer CNS prophylaxis with intrathecal methotrexate 12 mg
mn_mandates_cns_prophylaxis.note: Phrased as 'offer', but IT MTX plus MRI/LP is the committed plan for an intermediate-risk patient.

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: Use Lugano 2014 criteria with the 5-point Deauville PET scale

resp_ds45_biopsy.quote: biopsy first if the uptake is equivocal

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: Start allopurinol 300 mg PO daily 1 to 2 days before C1, with oral or IV hydration as tolerated

sup_gcsf.quote: Primary G-CSF: pegfilgrastim 6 mg SC on day 4 of each cycle
